messages:
Maya: heads-up - ran into repeated soft OOMs on a 16k seq run when continuous batching tries to pack >8k kv tokens. saw ~3 regressions in prod since the kernel route change.
Ravi: ugh. which kernel route did you land? the hybrid-slowpath one?
Maya: rolled kernel-selector v2.2 - prefers fused-attn for short seqs, fallback path hits for long kv-heavy requests. noticed batch formation doesn't account for kv evictions.
Kim: can you paste the profiler snapshot? perf-bot: profile attached below.
perf-bot: p95 latency +18% on long-kv workload, CUDA memory spike at the batch-assemble stage. sample:
```
batch_assemble    120ms   38%  // CPU time
kv_materialize    75ms    24%  // GPU staging
kernel_select     15ms    5%
```
Maya: looks like when many requests with large prefix cache entries queue, we attempt to form one giant mini-batch and then fail eviction, causing soft OOM retries.
Aditya: idea: add a pre-admit step that computes per-request kv-footprint and enforces a per-mini-batch kv_budget. if sum(kv_size) > kv_budget, split by LIFO or by kv_size descending.
Zhen: +1 for kv_budget. also propose a soft-reserve slab: reserve N tokens worth of KV memory per active context to prevent complete eviction storms.
Ravi: question - how to estimate kv_size cheaply without deserializing the whole cache entry? we need a fast heuristic in admission path.
Maya: use metadata size + estimated compression factor. we already have kv_entry_meta.bytes and kv_entry.tokens_est. multiply tokens_est * per_token_kv_bytes.
Kim: sounds ok. also throttle batch growth rate: limit growth to +20% batches/sec if cache pressure high, fall back to single-request kernel when failing.
Aditya: let's try this plan: (1) compute kv_est per request; (2) maintain rolling kv_budget per GPU node (configurable); (3) when forming a batch, if addition would exceed kv_budget, split the request into next batch and prefer small-first packing. implement a fast path in admission to avoid lock contention.
Maya: plan LGTM. I'll prototype a mini-batch splitter. will also add a metric kv_budget_utilization and a tag for "split_reason=kv_pressure".
perf-bot: experiment suggestion: run canary with kv_budget=0.7 * device_kv_capacity and batch_max_growth=1.2 for 24h.
Kim: @Maya please also add a counter for failed_evictions and soft_oom_retries so we can correlate.
Maya: will do. ETA EOD for a CL and perf dashboard tile.
ops-bot: deployment note: remember to flag rollback window 2hrs for this canary. :rotating_light:
Ravi: thanks team. if the prototype shows improvement we can try dynamic kv_budget that decays when evictions spike.
